# open-entity-gateway-picogrid-ecn

An optional adapter for [open-entity-gateway](../../README.md) that publishes tracks as entities to a Picogrid Expeditionary C2 Node through Picogrid's ECN SDK (`picogrid-ecn-client`, MPL-2.0), installed from PyPI as a dependency. See [docs/adapters/picogrid-ecn.md](../../docs/adapters/picogrid-ecn.md).

Status: built; measured against the SDK's offline mock; not run against an ECN.
